name: ZC Forward Curve: Contango Frequency & Carry Cost
description: Corn (ZC) forward curve analysis focused on contango frequency and annualized carry cost. Uses NoAdjustment futures_continuation with spread_depth=1. Key metrics: front spread (M1-M2 in cents/bu), carry signal (M1/M2-1), contango flag (carry < 0), 60-day rolling contango frequency, full-period contango frequency, and annualized carry (scaled by 365/60 for ~60-day average corn contract spacing). Outputs: summary snapshot table, front spread line chart with zero reference, and rolling 60-day contango frequency chart with 50% reference line.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN (ZC) FORWARD CURVE: CONTANGO FREQUENCY & ANNUALIZED CARRY
# =============================================================================
# Focus: (1) How often is ZC in contango? (2) What is the annualized carry cost?
#
# Data: ZC via market_data_source with NoAdjustment futures_continuation
# - cont.spread (M1 - M2, spread_depth=1): calendar spread in cents/bu
# - cont.carry (M1/M2 - 1): term structure signal
#   Positive = backwardation (front > back), Negative = contango (front < back)
#
# Annualized carry: cont.carry * (365/60)
#   60 days ~ average interval between adjacent corn contract months
#
# Contango flag: carry < 0 (M2 > M1)
# Rolling contango freq: 60-day rolling mean of contango flag
# Full-period contango freq: expanding mean of contango flag
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZC Corn Futures (NoAdjustment for true price levels) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Core term structure signals ---
front_spread = cont.spread        # M1 - M2 in cents/bu
carry = cont.carry                # M1/M2 - 1

# --- Contango flag & frequency ---
is_contango = carry < 0           # True when front < back (contango)

# Rolling 60-day contango frequency (0-1 range, displayed as %)
rolling_contango_60d = ma(period=60)(is_contango)

# Full-period expanding contango frequency
full_contango_freq = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_contango)

# --- Annualized carry cost ---
# Scale carry by 365/60 (approx days between adjacent corn contract months)
ann_carry = carry * (365.0 / 60.0)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table
# Current front spread, annualized carry, full-period & rolling contango freq
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZC Forward Curve Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Front Spread', 'Carry Cost'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Contango %'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Front Spread (cents/bu)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Full-Period Contango Frequency', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Annualized Carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Rolling 60d Contango Frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(front_spread, full_contango_freq, ann_carry, rolling_contango_60d)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Front Spread (M1 - M2) Over Time
# Above zero = backwardation, below zero = contango
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZC Front Spread (M1-M2)',
    category='2. Front Spread',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M1 - M2 Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(front_spread,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Rolling 60-Day Contango Frequency
# Shows % of trailing 60 days where front spread was in contango
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Contango Frequency',
    category='3. Contango Frequency',
    y_axis_label='% Days in Contango',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Contango Freq', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(rolling_contango_60d,))
